description: NaSrLaWO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.15 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. La is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All La-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent LaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.93 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, two equivalent La, and one W atom.
